workloadNotes: Uptime Kuma is socket.io-first, so the workload is both halves: the real HTTP routes (entry-page, badges via the badge renderer, status pages, metrics, SPA catch-all) and a socket.io client driving the setup/login/monitor/tag/status-page/settings event handlers — the surface no HTTP request reaches.
deviations: uptime-kuma's frontend bundle was not part of the frozen materialization (corpus.json declares build:null) and server.js exits without dist/index.html. The repo's own `npm run build` was run untraced before measurement; every file it produced is outside the frozen universe and is reported there.

curve.detail: entry page, setup info, SPA shell and the static/catch-all routes — 6/6 succeeded, 6/6 answered
socket.io event surface (setup, login, add monitor, beats, charts, tags, status page, settings) then badge/metrics routes — runner exit 0
badge renderer, status page render, push API and prometheus metrics — 9/11 succeeded, 11/11 answered
